text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин doesn't clinch the win at
the
Satsuki Sho—the first race of the
Classic Triple
Crown—but she
mesmerizes the crowd with her
powerful
performance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the stands is a young, redheaded girl
who is
moved to tears by her incredible
run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин leaves the racecourse to
hone her
skills and prepare for the next
challenge—the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
